---
title: "RSS feeds"
---

```{r}
#| eval: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidyRSS)
library(rvest)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

feeds <- c(
  "https://www.cityam.com/category/opinion/feed/",
  "https://www.theguardian.com/tone/editorials/rss",
  "https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/opinion/feed/"
)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

articles <- map(feeds, tidyfeed) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  select(feed_title, item_title, item_link, item_pub_date) |>
  group_by(feed_title) |>
  arrange(desc(item_pub_date)) |>
  slice_head(n = 5) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    original_file = paste0("data/opinion/", row_number(), "_original.html"),
    stripped_file = paste0("data/opinion/", row_number(), "_stripped.html")
  )
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

dir.create("data/opinion")
pages <- map(articles$item_link, read_html, encoding = "UTF-8")
walk2(pages, articles$original_file, xml2::write_html)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

example <- articles |> filter(str_detect(feed_title, "The Sun")) |> slice_head()
elements <- read_html(example$original_file, encoding = "UTF-8") |>
  html_elements(".article__content *")
tibble(
  element = xml2::xml_name(elements),
  class = html_attr(elements, "class"),
  text = html_text2(elements)
)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

bodies <- map(pages, html_elements, paste(
  "[data-gu-name='standfirst'], .article-body-viewer-selector,",
  "article.content-container__single, .article__content"
))
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

unwanted <- paste(
  "header, footer, aside, script, style, button, .notice-header, .newsletter-auto-inject,",
  "img, picture, svg, video, audio, iframe,",
  ".social-icons-wrapper, .advert-wrapper, .inline-module--newsletter,",
  ".article-readmore, .rail-container, .digital-personalisation, .comments__anchor,",
  "[data-spacefinder-type$='NewsletterSignupBlockElement'],",
  "li:contains('Do you have an opinion on the issues raised')"
)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

map(bodies, html_elements, unwanted) |> walk(xml2::xml_remove)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

html <- map(bodies, as.character) |> map_chr(paste, collapse = "\n")
stripped <- paste("<body>", html, "</body>") |> map(minimal_html)
walk2(stripped, articles$stripped_file, xml2::write_html)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

write_csv(articles, "data/opinion/metadata.csv")
```
